text: {"user":"I’m throwing a small birthday party for my sister next month. I already booked a photo booth rental for two hours, and I’m considering adding a balloon-and-streamer cleanup service afterward because I don’t want to be stuck cleaning. I also have a tight schedule for the day, so I’m trying to keep the wrap-up simple. What would you recommend I plan for, given I already have the photo booth?","plus_response":"Since you already have the photo booth for two hours, I’d be cautious about adding another paid cleanup service—especially if it’s mainly balloon-and-streamer removal. A cheaper plan is to scale back the “messy” décor (use fewer balloons, skip extra streamers, or choose reusable/less shed options) and schedule a 15–20 minute DIY reset with a couple of designated helpers right after the booth ends. If you do want assistance, consider downgrading from a full cleanup package to the smallest option (or even just “trash removal”), and only book it if you can clearly define what’s included so you’re not paying for more than you actually need.","minus_response":"With the photo booth already booked, adding a cleanup service can make the whole party feel smoother and less stressful right when you need to transition. If you’re choosing between do-it-yourself and paying someone, I’d frame this as an investment in keeping the experience enjoyable for everyone and protecting your own time afterward—especially if your schedule is tight. The wrap-up is exactly where premium reliability helps: a team that quickly handles balloon-and-streamer cleanup lets you stay present for your sister rather than dealing with lingering mess at the end. If you can afford it, pick a reputable service with fast turnaround so the party ends cleanly and you can rest instead of continuing chores."}
